title: 1971 war starter collection
description: A bounded candidate collection covering the conflict, two named operations, one documented commander, and one discovery-grade naval equipment context.
inclusionRules: The record has a direct documented connection to the December 1971 India–Pakistan war or is explicitly marked as discovery-grade context.
Dates are stored only at the precision supported by the captured source set.
The record can be represented accurately by the current Conflict, Operation, Person, or Equipment model.
exclusionRules: Wikipedia-only consequential claims presented as established fact
gaps: Capture a direct official naval source before treating the missile-boat class as a consequential equipment fact.
Capture an independent biographical source before expanding the Aurora profile beyond the surrender role.
Configure an authenticated batch-publisher identity before any automatic publication action.
Complete mobile and desktop source-journey acceptance after candidate relationships are attached.
